shortDescription.default: Vantage - work management and verified archive & retention for SharePoint

longDescription.default: Vantage brings boards, tasks, comments, checklists, dependencies and notifications to SharePoint Online, organised in secure workspaces with their own Administrators, Contributors and Readers groups. Completed work is moved to an archive list with its related records and attachments, verified field by field and by checksum before anything is removed, and can be restored. Runs entirely on SharePoint REST with the signed-in user's permissions: no Entra ID app registration or API permissions are required.
